takes.title: Walk with Small Steps and Turn
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, walks with small steps and low arm swings, then turns into profile near the end.

takes.title: Walk Forward and Turn into Profile
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks forward with a restrained arm swing, then turns sideways and settles into a standing stance.

takes.title: Give Open-Hand Signals and Briefly Raise Both Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates crossed forearms and outward gestures, then lifts both hands near the head and lowers the arms to finish.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with a Low Side Bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer sweeps one arm out, repeatedly lifts it while the other hand rests at the waist, then folds to the side. The take ends upright with one hand on the hip.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Wide Reaches and a Crouch
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly lifts one hand, opens both arms, and drops briefly into a low crouch before returning to raised-arm gestures. They finish standing.

takes.title: Give Standing Signals with Hand Lifts Near the Head
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates crossed forearms, open-handed reaches, and higher gestures around the head. The arms lower at the end.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with Alternating Side Leans
takes.actionDescription: The performer extends one arm with the other at the hip, alternates small side leans, then bends more deeply. They straighten with one hand drawn in.

takes.title: Open Both Hands and Reach Diagonally Up
takes.actionDescription: The performer gestures near the face, opens both hands, and reaches upward to one side before returning to compact gestures. They finish upright with arms lowered.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Hand Lifts and Open Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates hand-to-face motions, crossed forearms, and wide gestures, with a short bent-knee dip. They finish upright with arms lowered.

takes.title: Alternate Hand-to-Head Gestures with Side Leans
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, repeatedly brings one hand near the head, opens the arms, and reaches up while leaning. Both arms lower before the end.

takes.title: Alternate Overhead Reaches and Compact Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts both arms overhead, alternates with one-handed reaches and gestures near the chest, and finishes standing with one hand drawn in.

takes.title: Mime a Prairie Dog with Compact Hand Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands near the upper chest, repeatedly flexes the knees, and makes one deeper dip before standing nearly upright again.

takes.title: Mime a Bear with Alternating High Arm Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens the arms, repeatedly lifts one forearm and leans sideways, then returns to an upright stance with the arms lowered.

takes.title: Mime a Dog with Repeated Forward Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends and straightens repeatedly with the elbows close and hands near the torso, then finishes upright with arms down.

takes.title: Mime a Cat with Side Leans and Face-Level Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings a hand near the head, alternates side bends and forward reaches, and finishes with a hand raised near the head.

takes.title: Mime an Elephant with Low and Overhead Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates deep forward leans with both hands stretched out and upright overhead lifts. They finish upright with the arms drawn in.

takes.title: Mime a Mouse with Small Forward Bows
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeats compact hand gestures near the chest while leaning forward, then straightens and lowers the arms near the sides.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Elbows Out and Knee Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the elbows away from the torso while shifting weight and making shallow knee bends. They finish upright with one hand raised.

takes.title: Mime a Dinosaur with Raised Forearms and a Deep Fold
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates forward and raised-arm gestures, bends sharply toward the floor, then returns to standing with one hand near the face.

takes.title: Mime a Snake with Forward Folds and an Overhead Arc
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens bent forward, alternates low folds with an overhead reach, and finishes upright with the arms lowered.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Alternating Arm Lifts and Side Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly leans to one side and lifts an arm beside or above the head. The take ends upright with both arms down.
